metaTitle: LAMÓWKA - Jan Matejko x Lady Gaga, the crossover nobody saw coming

runs.text: #OkresNoStres: menstrual education from the Bella brand

Bella has launched #OkresNoStres — “a period, no stress” — an education program aimed at young girls going through their first period. The program's main goal is to break down the fear and push back against misinformation about menstruation. Even with easy access to all kinds of material, plenty of young girls still wrestle with anxiety around this important moment in their lives.

#OkresNoStres runs in partnership with schools across Poland, and the knowledge about menstruation is passed on through printed and online materials and through social media. The initiative is meant to reach the girls and the adults looking after them alike, offering support and reliable information.
Jan Matejko's Stańczyk at the Louvre and on a Lady Gaga album cover

One of the most recognizable works of Polish art, Jan Matejko's “Stańczyk”, has turned up somewhere unusual — on the cover of the vinyl edition of Lady Gaga's album “Harlequin”. That remarkable pairing of high art with pop culture is drawing plenty of attention, and the surprises don't end there. The painting will also be part of the “Figures du Fou” exhibition at the Louvre in Paris. Who would have thought Stańczyk would find a place in such a modern setting?
YES and Krzysztof Zalewski – jewelry for men

YES, the Polish jewelry brand, is carrying on with its jewelry revolution and this time has gone for a collaboration with the musician Krzysztof Zalewski. The partnership has produced a men's jewelry collection reflecting a spread of symbols — from a lion, through a jellyfish, all the way to a guitar pick. Zalewski proves that jewelry for men can be every bit as intriguing as the kind made for women. The collection launched on 9 October.
Instagram has a new version of Emoji Pong

Instagram is refreshing its popular Emoji Pong game with a new interface and extra features that users are certain to take an interest in. It's a good excuse to liven up interaction on the platform and challenge your friends to a duel. On top of that, 38 new stickers have landed for Stories and Reels, which opens up even more room for making original content.
Meta, TikTok and Snapchat together against harmful content

Meta, TikTok and Snapchat have joined forces to fight harmful content together, particularly anything to do with self-harm. The “Thrive” project is meant to detect and remove dangerous material faster, looking after users' safety. It is a very important initiative, especially for the younger part of the community.
